prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: decorative raster background for the SalaryMate financial website, designed for readable UI overlays.
Primary request: create exactly ONE original wide landscape 16:9 background on white to very light ivory watercolor paper. Inspired by the inspected reference images: extremely pale mint/aqua and butter-yellow washes, soft round handpainted Japanese shrine travel illustration mood, playful friendly simplicity, faint colored-pencil grain. This is an original composition using their palette and texture, not a reproduction.
Scene/backdrop: nearly blank cream-white paper; the middle 80 percent remains very quiet and visually empty, with only an extremely subtle paper grain. Put delicate pastel watercolor washes mostly along the outer edges. A few tiny pale yellow stars and small fluffy friendly clouds may hug the margins. A small smiling cream-yellow moon sits at the far upper-right margin. At the bottom-right edge only, include a small softly painted mint/aqua shrine roof and gate suggestion, partially cropped by the edge, with soft butter-yellow accents. All decorative elements stay faint and small; nothing competes with overlaid financial panels.
Style/medium: cheerful handpainted watercolor and dry colored pencil, soft imperfect edges, restrained pigment, delicate paper grain. Flat 2D illustration with plenty of white space.
Composition/framing: landscape 16:9, use the full canvas, central 80 percent blank. Edge motifs feel airy and incidental rather than a border frame.
Color palette: white paper, very light ivory, pale aqua, mint, butter yellow. Very low contrast.
Text: none.
Constraints: no text, labels, lettering, logos, watermark, numbers, UI, dashboard panels, people or other characters; only the tiny smiling moon has a face. No large focal object, no 3D candy, no glossy plastic rendering, no dark outlines, no saturated colors. Generate one single image only.
notes: All four supplied reference images inspected. References informed palette and texture only. Single original image generated; no retries or variants.
